note: Salesforce Push sends Drupal entity changes to Salesforce, driven by each salesforce_mapping's push sync-triggers (push_create/push_update/push_delete) and per-mapping limits (push_limit, push_retries, push_frequency), through the queue.salesforce_push queue and salesforce_push_queue_processor plugins (Rest). Actual delivery needs a Salesforce connection, so all medium/hard cases are grounded in the LOCAL salesforce_mapping config (push triggers + push_limit), created/read/modified with no connection and verified by pure entity reads. Namespaced sfp_* mappings are removed on cleanup.

evals.prompt: How does Salesforce Push decide when to send a Drupal entity change to Salesforce - what determines whether create/update/delete are pushed?
evals.expected_output: It is driven by the salesforce_mapping's sync_triggers: push_create, push_update and push_delete. Entity insert/update/delete hooks push (or enqueue) to Salesforce for each mapping whose matching push trigger is enabled.

evals.prompt: In Salesforce Push, how are asynchronous pushes processed, and what plugin type handles processing the push queue?
evals.expected_output: Async pushes go into the queue.salesforce_push queue and are processed by salesforce_push_queue_processor plugins (the shipped Rest processor). Processing happens on cron (salesforce_push_cron) or via the standalone push endpoint when salesforce.settings.standalone is enabled.

evals.prompt: Which settings limit how many records Salesforce Push processes - globally and per mapping?
evals.expected_output: Globally, salesforce.settings.global_push_limit caps records per queue run. Per mapping, the salesforce_mapping has push_limit, push_retries and push_frequency.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Salesforce mapping sfp_med. Inspect its live configuration and say whether it pushes to Salesforce when the Drupal entity is updated.
evals.expected_output: Yes: sfp_med has sync_triggers.push_update = true, so it pushes on Drupal entity update.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Salesforce mapping sfp_lim with a custom per-mapping push limit. Inspect its live configuration and give the push_limit value.
evals.expected_output: The push_limit is 42: salesforce_mapping sfp_lim has push_limit = 42.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a Salesforce mapping sfp_task that does not push deletions. Configure it so that deleting the Drupal entity also deletes the mapped Salesforce record (enable the push-on-delete trigger). Apply the change to the live site.
On this Drupal site there is a Salesforce mapping sfp_ltask. Set its per-mapping push limit to 25 records. Apply the change to the live site.
